generate_sorting_network: generate a valid sorting network for a given sequence length using random comparison operators
test_network: test whether a list of comparison operators forms a valid sorting network for a sequence length
get_test_cases: generate all possible binary truth table inputs for a given sequence length
operators_to_graphstuple: convert a list of comparison operators into a jraph GraphsTuple graph representation
generate_sorting_network_batch: generate a batch of sorting network graphs in parallel using numba multithreading
